rule_packs.name: Canton of Zürich building act
rule_packs.law: Planungs- und Baugesetz des Kantons Zürich (PBG, LS 700.1), as in force on 1 January 2026
rule_packs.note: A pre-check of a few rules, not a compliance certificate.
rule_packs.fail_means: It would not meet the Canton of Zürich's rule; other cantons set their own.

rules.title: A bedroom or living room is at least 10 m2 (canton of Zürich)

applies_to.note: Canton of Zürich only: Swiss building law is cantonal and there is no national limit. Rooms for living and sleeping (PBG s. 299). Not in single-family houses and comparable dwellings (s. 303). A dining area that is part of an open room (Essen, Repas, Pranzo) is not a room of its own and is not checked; kitchens are left out (the government may set other rules for them).

clause.ref: Planungs- und Baugesetz des Kantons Zürich (PBG, LS 700.1), § 303 Abs. 1
clause.quote: Die Mindestfläche von Räumen, ausser solchen in Einfamilienhäusern und bei vergleichbaren Wohnungsarten, beträgt 10 m².
clause.quote_en: The minimum area of rooms, except those in single-family houses and comparable kinds of dwelling, is 10 m2.

rule_packs.name: Finland: homes and accessibility decrees
rule_packs.law: Rakentamislaki 751/2023; decrees 1008/2017 (homes and rooms) and 241/2017 (accessibility), kept in force by the entry-into-force provision of Act 752/2023
rule_packs.note: A pre-check of a few rules, not a compliance certificate.
rule_packs.fail_means: It would not meet today's rule for a new building.

rules.title: A bedroom or living room is at least 7 m2

applies_to.note: New buildings, extensions and substantial changes of use (decree 1008/2017 s. 1); in a repair the original solution may be kept. Habitable rooms only: not a hall, corridor, bathroom or the like (s. 2). A dining nook that is part of an open room (labels R, RT, RH, RUOK, RUOKAILU, Essen, Repas, Pranzo) is not a room of its own and is not checked, nor is an alcove (ALKOVI). Kitchens are left out: a plan does not tell a kitchen (a habitable room) from a kitchenette. Floor under 1.6 m of headroom does not count (s. 2), which a plan does not show.

clause.ref: Ympäristöministeriön asetus asuin-, majoitus- ja työtiloista 1008/2017, 4 § 2 mom.
clause.quote: Asuin-, majoitus- ja työtilan huonealan on kuitenkin aina oltava vähintään 7 neliömetriä.
clause.quote_en: The room area of a residential, accommodation or work space must, however, always be at least 7 square metres.
